unknown_policy.product: Incomplete collection, exhausted budget, mutable identity, divergent commit or provider failure cannot become COMPLETE or create an improper top_choice. Unsupported locale is a validation error. Unknown license is warning-only unless incompatibility is proven.
unknown_policy.discriminatory_gate: Only cases whose class is opaque may produce Unknown. Unknown never counts as rejection or success and opaque cases are excluded from the mutation-score denominator.

negative_cases.minimal_mutation: omit bateia_recommend, duplicate it, rename it, or announce any fourth tool
negative_cases.attack: call tools/list after initialize
negative_cases.expected_witness: the advertised name multiset is exactly bateia_search, bateia_benchmark and bateia_recommend, each once
negative_cases.reject_if: the exact tool set or multiplicity differs

negative_cases.minimal_mutation: remove exactly one required declaration for idea.problem, idea.capabilities or policy.schema_version from the announced schema or runtime validation
negative_cases.attack: for each field, submit the base fixture with only that field absent
negative_cases.expected_witness: the field is required by tools/list and the call is rejected before every provider; zero provider calls
negative_cases.reject_if: the tool runs, a provider is touched, or the missing field is silently synthesized

negative_cases.minimal_mutation: replace the recommendation service call with RunIdeaRecommendCommand or materialize one temporary, replay or output file

negative_cases.expected_witness: the injected recommendation interface is called exactly once and no filesystem operation or CLI command entrypoint is observed
negative_cases.reject_if: the MCP invokes the CLI, creates a path, or obtains the result by reading a dossier

negative_cases.reject_if: status is COMPLETE, evidence state is upgraded, or an inconclusive candidate becomes top_choice

negative_cases.minimal_mutation: retain one accidental iteration order in canonical output

negative_cases.attack: send the same request twice in one server process and once in a fresh process using resettable deterministic fakes
negative_cases.expected_witness: all three MCP text payloads are byte-identical and each call produces the same provider-call trace without run_id, persisted job state or hidden replay
negative_cases.reject_if: the second call depends on the first, receives a synthetic run_id, skips work through global state, or returns different canonical bytes

opaque_cases.construction: the fake provider returns a sanitized generic failure that cannot identify whether discovery or content collection failed
opaque_cases.expected_product_witness: status INCONCLUSIVE, failure preserved, no fabricated absence and no improper top_choice
opaque_cases.reason: the fixture proves opacity preservation but cannot discriminate which internal stage mutation caused it

opaque_cases.construction: budget ends with discovered candidates but no immutable assessment for any candidate
opaque_cases.expected_product_witness: status INCONCLUSIVE, incomplete work remains observable, no evidence upgrade and no improper top_choice
opaque_cases.reason: without an assessment witness the case cannot distinguish alternative ranking implementations

opaque_cases.construction: all candidates use HEAD, an empty commit, or discovery and assessment commits that diverge
opaque_cases.expected_product_witness: status INCONCLUSIVE, identity opacity remains explicit and no improper top_choice is emitted
opaque_cases.reason: no immutable repository identity exists from which to prove a complete recommendation

opaque_cases.construction: the only capability evidence is in a collected format unsupported by the sealed parsers
opaque_cases.expected_product_witness: status INCONCLUSIVE, capability is not promoted to PROVEN and raw content is not returned
opaque_cases.reason: unsupported parsing supplies no grounded positive or negative capability witness

opaque_cases.construction: cancellation races with a provider call already admitted before the deterministic barrier
opaque_cases.expected_product_witness: no call starts after cancellation and the run does not become COMPLETE; completion of the already-started call is not prescribed
opaque_cases.reason: the frozen contract constrains new collections after cancellation, not the scheduler outcome of work already started

mutation_score.unknown_rule: Unknown for any negative case scores as surviving, not rejected
mutation_score.seal_rule: every negative mutation must be rejected and every opaque case must remain explicitly Unknown or the contract cannot be sealed
